Area.evidence_source: Twelve (20%) prisoners said they had contemplated the act for three hours or less and 24 (40%) for more than three hours. Twenty-four (40%) prisoners acted impulsively in that they said they did not think about the act for longer than a few minutes: When my mind tells me I'm going to do something, I'm going to do it and it's instant ... bang. It was spur of the moment. (Case 17)
